title: Cross-run report discovery is keyed by tick_id, which does not distinguish two repositories sharing one ExecStateRoot
body: A host running epics of two different repositories with one ExecStateRoot and colliding tick ids would be offered the other repository's reports: the attempt record's tick_id matches by name, and nothing durable in it identifies the repository across clones (repo is a host path, repo_key a hash of the host git path, job_id names only the run and tick). Within one tracker — the normal case — keying by tick_id is exact, since tick ids are unique per tracker. A durable remote/tracker identity on the attempt record would close it.
